title: Probability after dropping a prefix
statement: Let $S,n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $P$ be a predicate on Boolean words. The probability that the suffix after the first $S$ bits of a uniformly random Boolean word of length $S+n$ satisfies $P$ equals the probability that a uniformly random Boolean word of length $n$ satisfies $P$.
